text:
Add a planning check that runs before the critic. When a reading or plan adds a rule that matches text or refuses an input, the plan must name at least one real input from the incident and show the rule's condition firing on it. Example inputs: an audience proposal built by audience.rs, a shipped verifier.md, or a past request. The plan must also name one concrete point where the rule is enforced and must not leave the rule unwired. If either is missing, send the plan back to the planner before the critic sees it. Add a test that seeds a plan with no real-input demonstration and asserts that it is sent back.

Acceptance:
- The change is made as described: Plans for a new matching or refusal rule never run the draft rule on the real inputs it must catch, so planning fails every round
- No unrelated behavior changes; the existing tests pass
- fmt, clippy and test pass

Files: audience.rs, verifier.md
